titre: L'emballage tient, les papiers graphiques décrochent
sous_titre: Production européenne de papier et carton, variation 2025 par rapport à 2024, en pourcentage

Ensemble papier et carton.texte: The production decreased by 1.5% compared to the previous year.

Papiers graphiques.texte: Graphic paper production, still more fragile than other segments, decreased by 7.2% in 2025.

Papiers et cartons d'emballage.texte: Focusing only on packaging paper and board (+0,1%), tissue paper (-0.8%) and other paper and board (+0.4%)

Papier ouate.texte: packaging paper and board (+0,1%), tissue paper (-0.8%) and other paper and board (+0.4%)

Autres papiers et cartons.texte: tissue paper (-0.8%) and other paper and board (+0.4%), European production looked relatively stable in 2025
